user.title: Connect Dreame lawn mower
user.description: Sign in with your Dreamehome or MOVAhome account to discover mower devices.

device.title: Select mower
device.description: Choose one mower to add. Run setup again to add another mower from the same account.

reauth.title: Reconnect account
reauth.description: Update your Dreamehome or MOVAhome credentials.

reconfigure.title: Update mower connection
reconfigure.description: Update the login details or region for this mower. The account must still contain the configured mower; its Home Assistant entry and entities are kept.

data.map_restart_preview: Keep a map preview across restarts

data_description.map_restart_preview: Off by default. Stores one private map JPEG (up to 2 MB) in Home Assistant. Only previews less than 24 hours old are used while the matching map loads; they are not live mower state. Disabling this option or deleting the integration removes the stored preview.
data_description.map_rotation: Fallback rotation for maps without a per-map selection. Use the Selected Map Display Rotation entity for individual maps.
data_description.map_theme: Choose a coordinated light, dark, midnight, or high-contrast palette for all locally rendered maps.
data_description.map_stroke_scale: Scale map boundaries and paths from 0.5 to 3.
data_description.map_marker_scale: Scale map points and the live mower marker from 0.5 to 3.
data_description.map_marker_image: Optional PNG, JPEG, or WebP inside Home Assistant's config/www folder, for example mower/marker.png or /local/mower/marker.png. Files outside that folder and files larger than 1 MB are ignored.
data_description.map_spot_area_style: Hide saved spot-mowing rectangles for a clean Dreame-like map, show only their outlines, or restore the filled diagnostic overlay. This affects locally rendered vector maps only.
data_description.map_mowing_path_style: Hide completed mowing passes, render them subtly, or show every pass in full detail. The live route and mower marker remain visible.
data_description.notification_mode: Create persistent Home Assistant notifications for mower conditions. Notifications use one stable item per mower and condition, update when details change, and disappear when the condition clears. Off is the default; use the notification blueprint for mobile delivery, maintenance reminders, offline alerts, delays, repeats, or custom actions.
data_description.video_retention: Balanced gives snapshot previews a 60-second reconnect window and keeps XP2P ready for the current mowing run after someone opens live video. Battery saver always releases it shortly after the last consumer. Video priority also treats snapshot access as a reason to stay ready while mowing. All modes remain lazy until media is requested and stop when mower state blocks video.
data_description.video_transport: Auto is the fast default: it refreshes only mower safety state, then reuses health-checked provisioning and prefers a proven LAN route when firmware exposes one. Cloud remains the compatibility fallback. The tested A2 firmware does not expose Tencent's separate LAN service, so neither mode promises internet-independent startup.
data_description.xp2p_library_path: Advanced video option. Use a dynamic XP2P library built for this Home Assistant host OS and CPU. Android APK/AAR libraries and iOS frameworks are not host runtimes.
data_description.xp2p_runner_command: Advanced video option. Use only a local host runner that owns a compatible XP2P runtime and returns a local FLV URL. Android helpers are not the intended Home Assistant runtime.
data_description.xp2p_runner_mode: Use process mode for a runner that stays alive while Home Assistant streams.

start_scheduled_mowing.name: Start guarded scheduled mowing
start_scheduled_mowing.description: Refresh eligibility and start an explicit task, or skip immediately with a reason. Requires a docked, online mower, known inactive task and rain-delay state, sufficient battery, and disabled native schedules on every map. Does not queue a run or resume an existing task. Returns per-entity status and reason when response data is requested.

start_zone_mowing.name: Start zone mowing
start_zone_mowing.description: Start mower-native mowing for one or more saved zones on the active map and confirm that mowing started. Exact zone confirmation depends on the mower publishing native task metadata.

start_spot_mowing.name: Start spot mowing
start_spot_mowing.description: Start mower-native mowing for one or more saved spot areas on the active map and confirm that mowing started. Exact spot confirmation depends on the mower publishing native task metadata.

start_edge_mowing.name: Start edge mowing
start_edge_mowing.description: Start mowing for one or more explicit current-map edge contour IDs and confirm that mowing started. Exact mode confirmation depends on the mower publishing native task metadata. Each contour ID is a two-item list in the form [edge_id, contour_index].

start_point_patrol.name: Start point patrol
start_point_patrol.description: Send the mower to visit configured patrol points on the active map without mowing. When point_ids is omitted, every patrol point on the active map is visited. Use while the mower is docked or otherwise idle. Observed on MOVA LiDAX Ultra 1000 firmware; other models may reject the request.

start_edge_patrol.name: Start edge patrol
start_edge_patrol.description: Drive along one or more explicit current-map edge contours without mowing. Each contour ID is a two-item list in the form [edge_id, contour_index]. Use while the mower is docked or otherwise idle. Observed on MOVA LiDAX Ultra 1000 firmware; other models may reject the request.

download_session_photos.name: Download session photos
download_session_photos.description: Save the photos attached to the latest finished task sessions (for example point patrol photos) to the Home Assistant media folder under dreame_lawn_mower, grouped by entity and cloud object. Already saved photos are skipped. Limited to 100 photos and 64 MiB per call, with a 256 MiB archive per entity. Observed on MOVA LiDAX Ultra 1000 firmware; other models may not publish session photos.

download_person_photo.name: Download person photo
download_person_photo.description: Save the photo the mower took when it detected a person to the Home Assistant media folder, next to the session photos. Without detected_at, the latest retained human-detection notice (code 27) is used. Observed on MOVA LiDAX Ultra 1000 firmware; other models may store person photos differently.

switch_current_map.name: Switch current map
switch_current_map.description: Switch the mower's active app map by app map index. This updates the real active mower map, not just the local Home Assistant selection scope. Use while the mower is docked or otherwise idle; the vendor protocol may reject the request while mowing.

cancel_current_task.name: Cancel current task
cancel_current_task.description: End the mower's current mowing task without sending it to the dock. The service waits for authoritative inactive state before completing, so a map switch can safely follow it. Calling it while already idle has no effect.

plan_map_preference_mode_update.name: Plan map preference mode update
plan_map_preference_mode_update.description: Build or send a guarded preference-mode update for the selected map on the mower entity. This only changes the selected map between global and custom preference mode and does not require any zone selection. By default this is a dry run that only stores the candidate PREP request in the last preference write diagnostic sensor. Sending the request requires execute and confirm_preference_write to both be true.

plan_zone_mowing_preference_update.name: Plan zone mowing preference update
plan_zone_mowing_preference_update.description: Build or send a guarded mowing preference update for the selected map on the mower entity. Zone-scoped settings use the current Home Assistant map/zone selection scope unless zone_id is provided explicitly. Map-level preference_mode updates can be planned without any zone selection. By default this is a dry run that only stores the candidate PRE/PREP request in the last preference write diagnostic sensor. Sending the request requires execute and confirm_preference_write to both be true.

remote_control_step.name: Remote control step
remote_control_step.description: Send one validated manual-drive movement step to the mower. This can physically move the mower and is intended for short supervised tests only. The service is blocked while the mower is mowing, returning, mapping, fast mapping, in error, or below 20% battery.

remote_control_stop.name: Remote control stop
remote_control_stop.description: Send a zero-motion remote-control step to stop manual driving.

set_schedule_plan_enabled.name: Set schedule plan enabled
set_schedule_plan_enabled.description: Build or send a guarded app-schedule enable/disable request. By default this is a dry run that only shows the request payload in a notification. Sending the request requires execute and confirm_schedule_write to both be true. Use only during supervised testing.

set_schedule_task_start_time.name: Set existing schedule start time
set_schedule_task_start_time.description: Preview or change one existing all-area mowing start on an A2 V3 schedule. Qualified for map 0, plan 0. Preserves other tasks, names and enable flags. The mower must have finished its current task. Defaults to a dry run; sending requires execute and confirm_schedule_write. Creation, weekday changes and area edits remain unavailable.

plan_schedule_upload.name: Plan schedule upload
plan_schedule_upload.description: Build or send a guarded full schedule upload for one map slot. Provide a list of decoded schedule plans in the same readable shape returned by the schedule probe and calendar helpers. By default this is a dry run that only stores the candidate SCHDIV2/SCHDDV2 request sequence in the last schedule write diagnostic sensor. Sending the upload requires execute and confirm_schedule_write to both be true.

plan_maintenance_reset.name: Plan maintenance reset
plan_maintenance_reset.description: Build or send a guarded CMS maintenance counter reset. By default this is a dry run that only shows the candidate CMS request in a notification and the diagnostic sensor. Sending the request requires execute and confirm_maintenance_reset to both be true.

plan_mowing_preference_update.name: Plan mowing preference update
plan_mowing_preference_update.description: Build or send a guarded mower preference update from the current app preference payload. By default this is a dry run that only shows the candidate request payload in a notification and the diagnostic sensor. Sending the request requires execute and confirm_preference_write to both be true.
